title: Durable edited project document copies
target_user: A session-bound tenant editor who needs to reopen an edited project document
observed_problem: Browser edits are not persisted by the generation-time project snapshot or original server history, so page reload cannot restore a saved edited version through the current edit action.

evidence.observation: Editing changes the in-memory document; reopening server history loads the stored generation result.
Project auto-link persists generation-time result docs, not later browser edits.
The existing approved review scope excludes editing project documents.

current_workaround: Download the edited result immediately; this does not provide a durable project copy that can be reopened in the application.
desired_outcome: Save a separately identified edited copy, reopen it after reload, and download its persisted content without overwriting original documents or reviews.
acceptance_criteria: A strict parent-bound save creates one new immutable document and preserves the original document and review bytes.
An active session and permitted existing tenant role are required; foreign tenant, viewer and sessionless writes fail without mutation.
Exact operation replay returns the same copy after restart; changed replay, stale parent and corrupt state fail closed.
Conditional mutation preserves unrelated concurrent project changes on local and fake-S3 backends.
Saved copies retain parent and actor lineage but do not inherit approval, completed review or original-issued verification authority.
Real local browser save, reload, open and DOCX download preserve edited content and leave the original unchanged.
Failed saves retain unsaved text; duplicate clicks and stale auth/project responses cannot create misleading success state.
affected_boundaries: Project routes, schemas, service and ProjectStore conditional mutation
Session-bound authorization and redacted audit metadata
Browser editor, project document list and existing export integration
Local/fake-S3 API/store tests, browser E2E and product status documentation

allowed_effects: Create an immutable edited project copy in local/fake-S3 verification
Record parent linkage, operation identity and redacted local audit evidence
excluded_effects: Overwrite original generation history or review evidence
Inherit or grant operational, legal or contractual approval
Commit, push, publish, install or change credentials
separate_approval_required_for: Live AWS, provider or G2B calls
Dataset upload, model training, promotion or deployment

local_verification.proves: Edited-copy storage, API access, exact replay and existing project/approval contracts on isolated local/fake-S3 data.
Real local generation, edited-copy save, reload, open, DOCX download and successor-copy lineage on desktop/mobile.
Patch whitespace integrity, not runtime correctness

decision.rationale: The repository operator explicitly approved this proposed edited-copy persistence scope in the current conversation. External effects remain excluded.
